map.由流速与特征长度求弗劳德数: Find the Froude Number from Velocity and Characteristic Length
map.输入流速 v、特征长度 L、g，求弗劳德数。: Enter the velocity v, characteristic length L and g to find the Froude number.
map.Fr>1 为急流，Fr<1 为缓流。: Fr above 1 is supercritical flow and below 1 subcritical flow.
map.判明渠流态: Judging the flow regime in open channels
map.Fr = v/sqrt(g*L)。例：v=2 m/s、L=1 m，Fr=2/sq: Fr = v/sqrt(g*L). Example: with v=2 m/s and L=1 m, Fr=2/sqrt(9.81)=0.639; above 1 is supercritical and below 1 subcritical.
map.Fr=1 临界，区分急流/缓流，主导水面波形传播。: Fr=1 is critical, separating supercritical from subcritical flow and governing how surface waves travel.
map.船模相似？: What about similarity in ship models?
